Artie -- they had the girls and they were dancing.
He told Tony Pastor (inaudible), say,
"I brought him over. I wanted Tony to hear you,
because I wanted to hear a good tenor player."
He say, "I want Tony to learn how to
play like you play," you know.
And if you hear a lot of things like
Tony Pastor play, he sounds just like I do, because
Tony hanged out with me the whole time I was with the
band.
